description_en: Queries traffic throttling rules of a quality of service (QoS) policy
description_zh: 调用DescribeQosCars接口查询QoS策略实例的限速规则信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag describe-qos-cars --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-awfxl1adxeqyk0000 --qos-car-id qoscar-n5k8g97lihlph0000 --order asc --description testdesc --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeQosCars

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the QoS policy is created.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic throttling rule
parameters.name: qos_car_id

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the traffic throttling rules. Valid values:

asc: sorted in ascending order. This is the default value.
desc: sorted in descending order.

By default, traffic throttling rules are sorted in ascending order of priority
parameters.help_zh:
限速规则的排序方式。取值：

asc（默认值）：升序。
desc：降序。

默认按照限速规则的优先级升序排列
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The description of the traffic throttling rule
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的最大条目数。取值范围：1~50。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的最大条目数

QosCar.description_en: The list of traffic throttling rules

Description.description_en: The description of the traffic throttling rule

LimitType.description_en:
The type of traffic throttling. Valid values:

Absolute: throttles traffic based on a specific range of bandwidth.
Percent: throttles traffic based on a specific range of bandwidth percentage
LimitType.description_zh:
限速类型：

Absolute：按带宽值。

Percent：按百分比

Name.description_en: The name of the traffic throttling rule

PercentSourceType.description_en:
The bandwidth type when traffic is throttled based on bandwidth percentage.

CcnBandwidth: Cloud Connect Network (CCN) bandwidth.
InternetUpBandwidth: Internet upstream bandwidth
PercentSourceType.description_zh:
按百分比限速时的带宽类型：

CcnBandwidth：云连接网带宽。

InternetUpBandwidth：公网上行带宽

QosCarId.description_en: The ID of the traffic throttling rule

QosId.description_en: The ID of the QoS policy

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
